description: SessionStart: inject the always-on harness block (session-context.md) as additionalContext. PreToolUse (every tool): guard.sh keeps the four anchor-free invariants (rc=2 blocks). PostToolUse (EnterWorktree): enter-worktree.sh wires the harness ledger into the new story worktree (.beads/redirect + clone exclude) and runs the repos.json bootstrap fallback once when the target repo has no EnterWorktree hook of its own. Stop: ralph-cancel.sh (loop cancel marker) then stop-resume.sh (stop guard — pushes back while the ledger has in_progress work claimed by this session); both keep their state under ${HARNESS_DATA_DIR:-~/.claude/plugins/data/harness}.
